name: Metro Line 3 (Hinjawadi to Shivajinagar)
title: Pune Metro Line 3, Hinjawadi to Shivajinagar: status and timeline
summary: The metro line from Hinjawadi to Shivajinagar, built by PMRDA.
means: The line is built but not open. Until it runs, count your commute by road; a 'metro nearby' line in an ad means nothing yet.

history.status: The line missed its 15 July opening target.
The Commissioner of Metro Rail Safety cleared five more stations.

Ready to run but not open: five more stations were cleared for safety on 30 September, and the opening date is still not fixed because the Prime Minister's visit, expected for the inauguration, was deferred.
